questions.stem: A 26yr old G3A1P1 with 38 weeks of gestation presents with a history of pain abdomen, backache, contractions, and show. She has no comorbidities. Her first and second trimester USG is normal. On examination, P-90/min, saturation normal, afebrile, RR-14/min, BP-130/80mmHg, pallor present. Abdominal examination shows fundus just below xiphisternum, vertical lie, cephalic presentation, head engaged, FHR-140/min, contractions-5/10mins. PV examination shows cervix soft, effaced, 4cm dilated, 2cm long, head at station 0, membranes intact. NST is normal. She delivered a 3.2kg baby vaginally but had postpartum hemorrhage due to an Atonic uterus.
